biological.summary: KIF5B-RET is identified as the most common RET fusion in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), occurring in 1-3% of NSCLC patients. KIF5B provides the 5' sequences fused to 3' RET sequences encoding tyrosine kinase, creating an oncogenic fusion protein that drives tumor proliferation.

biological.citation: ALK-positive histiocytosis: a new clinicopathologic spectrum highlighting neurologic involvement and responses to ALK inhibition (PMID: 34727172)
biological.summary: KIF5B-ALK fusions were detected in 27 of 37 cases (73%) with confirmed ALK rearrangements in ALK-positive histiocytosis. KIF5B provides the 5' partner sequences fused to ALK kinase domain, with robust and durable responses observed in 11/11 patients treated with ALK inhibition.

biological.citation: DNA double-strand break-capturing nuclear envelope tubules drive DNA repair (PMID: 38632359)
biological.summary: KIF5B is a kinesin motor protein that collaborates with the LINC complex, NPC protein NUP153, nuclear lamina, and KIF13B to generate DSB-capturing nuclear envelope tubules (dsbNETs) that promote DNA repair and cell survival in response to DNA double-strand breaks.

biological.citation: Mechanisms of electroacupuncture-induced neuroprotection in acute stroke rats: the role of astrocyte-mediated mitochondrial transfer (PMID: 40598228)
biological.summary: KIF5b is identified as a protein associated with tunneling nanotubes (TNTs) involved in mitochondrial transfer from astrocytes to neurons. Electroacupuncture regulates KIF5b expression as part of a mechanism that facilitates mitochondrial transfer and provides neuroprotection during acute ischemic stroke in rats.

biological.citation: Low-intensity pulsed ultrasound improves myocardial ischaemia‒reperfusion injury via migrasome-mediated mitocytosis (PMID: 38951127)
biological.summary: KIF5B is a mitochondrial motor protein transcriptionally activated by YAP nuclear translocation downstream of the RhoA/Myosin II/F-actin pathway. KIF5B is essential for LIPUS-induced migrasome-dependent mitocytosis and removal of damaged mitochondria during myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury in mice.

biological.citation: A dual role of ERGIC-localized Rabs in TMED10-mediated unconventional protein secretion (PMID: 38926505)
biological.summary: KIF5B collaborates with Rab2A to regulate ERGIC compartmentalization and establish a UcPS-specific compartment, governing cargo translocation and specifying the ERGIC's function in unconventional protein secretion.

biological.citation: The cohesin-associated protein Pds5A governs the meiotic spindle assembly via deubiquitination of Kif5B in oocytes (PMID: 40215310)
biological.summary: Pds5A recruits deubiquitinase ubiquitin-specific protease 14 to stabilize kinesin family member 5B (Kif5B) on the spindle apparatus, regulating spindle elongation and meiotic spindle assembly during oocyte maturation. Pds5A depletion or genetic ablation leads to defects in spindle organization and compromised female fertility.

biological.citation: Endophilin A2 controls touch and mechanical allodynia via kinesin-mediated Piezo2 trafficking (PMID: 38475827)
biological.summary: KIF5B is a kinesin motor protein that interacts with EndoA2 adaptor protein to mediate membrane trafficking of the mechanically sensitive ion channel Piezo2 in dorsal root ganglion neurons. The KIF5B/EndoA2/Piezo2 complex is essential for Piezo2 trafficking and sustaining touch and mechanical pain signal transmission in mice and nonhuman primates.
biological.sample_size: Male and female C57BL/6 mice (8-12 weeks) and male cynomolgus monkeys (7-10 years old)

biological.citation: Inhibition of KIF5b-mediated Nav1.8 transport by ropivacaine contributes to axonal regeneration following sciatic nerve injury in rats (PMID: 39332671)
biological.summary: KIF5b mediates axonal transport of the voltage-gated sodium channel Nav1.8 from dorsal root ganglia to the lesion site following peripheral nerve injury. KIF5b overexpression impairs axonal regrowth, reduces macrophage infiltration and myelin debris clearance, and delays functional recovery; ropivacaine promotes axonal regeneration by inhibiting KIF5b-mediated Nav1.8 forward transport.

biological.citation: m6A-modified circCCAR1 promotes malignant proliferation by enhancing KIF5B expression in hepatocellular carcinoma (PMID: 40696234)
biological.summary: CircCCAR1 acts as a molecular sponge to sequester miR-641, relieving miR-641-mediated inhibition of KIF5B mRNA, and directly binds to PTBP1 which stabilizes KIF5B mRNA. KIF5B upregulation promotes HCC cell proliferation; silencing circCCAR1 suppresses HCC progression through the miR-641/KIF5B axis in cell culture and xenograft mouse models.
biological.sample_size: HCC cell lines and xenograft mouse model
